name: Pifo / Quito Expedition Launch
summary: Arrival, bike inspection, acclimatization and the mandatory route-verification briefing.
safetyNotes: Do not begin a maximum-effort stage immediately after a long flight.
Confirm fuel range, communications and weather before departure.
filmingNotes: Dawn loading sequence and stationary spatial-camera setup.
verificationNote: Geographic planning anchor; exact operating base must be contracted.

seasonalWeather.september: Cool, often clearer Andean mornings; strong UV.
seasonalWeather.october: Greener conditions with a higher afternoon shower risk.

sections.title: Start protocol
sections.body: Complete route verification, support check-in, motorcycle inspection and altitude briefing before unlocking operational guidance.

name: Rotary Coordination — Quito
summary: District 4400 coordination area for a consent-forward community or service visit.
safetyNotes: A map pin is not confirmation of a meeting or project.
Confirm host, address, consent and project scope before arrival.
filmingNotes: Prioritize the project and participants rather than expedition branding.
verificationNote: Rotary District 4400 confirms strong Quito presence; specific visit and address require direct confirmation.

seasonalWeather.september: Generally clearer mornings and cool evenings.
seasonalWeather.october: More frequent afternoon showers; carry rain protection.

sections.title: Community filming
sections.body: Use written consent, avoid filming minors without guardian permission and separate confirmed project facts from proposed activity.

name: Mitad del Mundo
summary: Optional cultural and equator-marker extension for the expedition opening or closing sequence.
safetyNotes: Use official visitor access and posted hours.
filmingNotes: Keep overlays historically precise and avoid implying that a monument alone defines the geodetic equator.
verificationNote: Confirm operating hours, permissions and exact filming rules.

seasonalWeather.september: Dry-season tendency with bright sun and cool wind.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: Present the site as a cultural stop and verify geodetic explanations before publishing narration.

name: Cayambe Volcano / Páramo Viewpoint
summary: High-Andes visual anchor with cold, wind, thin air and rapidly changing conditions.
safetyNotes: Treat altitude symptoms seriously and descend when required.
Confirm legal motor access; the pin is not a trail authorization.
filmingNotes: Use a stationary immersive pass-by with a protected camera zone.
verificationNote: Approximate scenic planning coordinate; local guide and access verification are mandatory.

seasonalWeather.september: Best chance of clearer high-country mornings; freezing wind remains possible.
seasonalWeather.october: More cloud, rain and mud risk; start early.

sections.title: Altitude protocol
sections.body: Acclimatize, hydrate, limit early exertion and retain a lower-elevation bailout route.

name: Papallacta Hot Springs
summary: Recovery stop where high-Andes cold transitions into cloud-forest mist.
safetyNotes: Watch for fog, wet pavement and temperature changes on E20.
filmingNotes: Steam provides depth for a stationary spatial shot; protect lenses from condensation.
verificationNote: Confirm lodging, access, rates and commercial filming permission.

seasonalWeather.september: Cold and misty despite the broader Andean dry season.

sections.title: Recovery
sections.body: Use this as a hydration, equipment-dryout and rider-health checkpoint rather than a late-night transfer.

name: Baeza Support / Bailout Junction
summary: Connector and support decision point between the E20 descent and E45 Amazon corridor.
safetyNotes: Confirm landslide, road and bridge conditions before committing south.
filmingNotes: Use only short route-transition graphics here.
verificationNote: Road status is live operational information and must be rechecked.

seasonalWeather.september: Rain remains possible in the cloud-forest transition.

sections.title: Go/no-go point
sections.body: Support lead records weather, road and rider status before the route changes from E20 to E45.

name: Archidona
summary: Amazon-foothills staging area for river, forest and community content.
safetyNotes: Expect heat, rain, insects and slick surfaces in both travel months.
filmingNotes: Do not enter community or Indigenous spaces without an invited local host and consent.
verificationNote: Exact trail, host and filming arrangements require local confirmation.

seasonalWeather.october: Warm, humid and often wetter; flexible timing required.

sections.title: Local protocol
sections.body: Use local guides, compensate community collaborators fairly and do not geotag sensitive places without permission.

name: Tena / Amazon Support Base
summary: Fuel, lodging, medical and support hub for the Amazon stage.
safetyNotes: Reassess river levels, rain and communications coverage.
filmingNotes: Capture environmental sound separately from narration.
verificationNote: Confirm current providers, hours and emergency capabilities.

seasonalWeather.september: Hot and humid with episodic heavy rain.

sections.title: Support reset
sections.body: Dry equipment, inspect air filters and brakes, recharge communications and confirm the next lodging before departure.

name: Rotary Coordination — Tena
summary: Potential District 4400 coordination point in the Amazon region.
safetyNotes: Do not represent a proposed stop as a confirmed Rotary project.
filmingNotes: Use consent-forward interviews and publish the confirmed host organization.
verificationNote: District 4400 identifies social reach in Tena; meeting, project and location are unconfirmed until directly arranged.

sections.title: Required confirmation
sections.body: Record club/contact, project owner, objectives, participant consent and whether technology delivery is requested.
